methodology: Read the actual current stage-structure.ts implementation directly (ciKeyword, stripTrailingFootnoteMarker, stripTrailingPageNumberArtifact, stripTrailingTypographicNoise, BOUNDED_GAP, the positional-signal gate) rather than trusting Workstream A's own self-assessment. Used scratch tsx probes against the real, unmodified parseDocumentStructure to explore the boundary of stripTrailingFootnoteMarker's regex before formalizing findings into a committed vitest file (tests/certification/part-b-recert-finding1-independent.test.ts). Grepped both committed remediation test files first to confirm every case below is genuinely new, not a rerun of Part A's own suite.

codeInspectionFinding_notAPhraseList.conclusion: CONFIRMED - the production mechanism is genuinely NOT a phrase/case special-case list.
codeInspectionFinding_notAPhraseList.evidence: ciKeyword builds a general per-letter case alternation for exactly one fixed keyword spelling (no enumerated word forms). stripTrailingTypographicNoise composes two general regex classes (a whitespace-bounded page/footer-number shape, and a punctuation-glued short digit run) with no document-identity, phrase, or fixture-specific literal anywhere. The positional plausibility gate (isPlausibleByPositionalSignals / precededByParagraphBreak / precededBySentenceTerminalPunctuation) inspects only WHERE whitespace/punctuation sits relative to the candidate, never WHAT WORDS precede it - confirmed by direct inspection, no citation-signal phrase array exists anywhere in the file (the old 14-phrase list this module's own history describes was already removed in an earlier phase). Test block 4 in the new file independently confirms this empirically: a heading preceded by an invented, never-before-seen transitional phrase ('Having duly considered the foregoing wherefore-clauses in their entirety...') is recognized purely from positional evidence, and a lowercase 'article' keyword mid-sentence after a semicolon (a position/punctuation combination absent from every existing test file) is also recognized. Both PASS.

findings.severity: PRIMARY - reproduces the original finding's own named failure mode
findings.title: A footnote/endnote marker glued to a bare closing bracket or quotation mark (no terminal punctuation mark of its own) still defeats both positional signals, dropping the heading entirely and reparenting its real child to parentSectionRef: null
findings.description: stripTrailingFootnoteMarker's regex, /(?<!\d)([.:;!?]["'’”)\]]*)\d{1,3}(\s*)$/, requires its match to BEGIN with a literal terminal-punctuation character ('.', ':', ';', '!', or '?'); a closing quote/paren/bracket is recognized only when it TRAILS that punctuation mark (the real, already-tested ')' + '.' order). It has no recognition at all for the equally common real shape where the closing bracket or quotation mark IS the last visible character of the sentence and the footnote/endnote digit is glued directly onto IT, with no separate terminal-punctuation mark anywhere - a genuinely common drafting/extraction shape: a sentence ending in a quoted defined term or a parenthetical cross-reference/qualifier with the footnote number glued straight onto the closing bracket/quote (either because the drafting convention never places a period there, or because plain-text PDF extraction is well documented to lose or merge a period that collides with an adjacent superscript glyph). Verified this is NOT covered by any case in either committed remediation test file (grepped both in full before writing).

concreteReproduction.inputText:
This Credit Agreement is entered into as of the date first written above (the "Agreement")1
ARTICLE I DEFINITIONS

Section 1.01 Defined Terms. Capitalized terms used herein have the meanings set forth below.
concreteReproduction.actualOutput: parseDocumentStructure returns exactly ONE node: SECTION ref=1.01 heading="Defined Terms" parentSectionRef=null. ARTICLE I is completely absent from the output.
concreteReproduction.expectedCorrectOutput: ARTICLE I DEFINITIONS should be recognized, and SECTION 1.01's parentSectionRef should be "I".
concreteReproduction.significance: This is not merely a missing index entry - it is the EXACT 'child re-parented to null' rank-stack corruption named verbatim in the original frozen finding (docs/phase-3f1-6-rx-final-blocker-closure/23-part-b-blocker1-blocker11-recertification.json), reproduced via a shape (closing-bracket-glued footnote, no separate terminal punctuation) distinct from the shape (punctuation-glued footnote) the remediation actually fixed.
concreteReproduction.isolatingControl: The IDENTICAL text with a period restored before the digit ('...(the "Agreement").1\nARTICLE I...') DOES correctly find ARTICLE I with SECTION 1.01 parented to it - confirming the finding is specific to the missing-punctuation shape, not to footnote markers or first-article documents in general. This control test PASSES.

findings.generalityConfirmed: Reproduces identically for a closing quotation mark instead of a closing parenthesis (block 2), and for a SECTION-level heading instead of only ARTICLE-level (block 3, where Section 6.02 is silently dropped) - this is a general gap in the typographic-noise-class definition itself, not a one-off shape.

findings.severity: SECONDARY - data-quality regression, not a false-negative or rank-stack defect
findings.title: When ARTICLE_PATTERNS[0]'s ALL-CAPS title-shape requirement fails to match (a genuinely lowercase-titled heading, now reachable at all because ciKeyword makes the keyword itself case-insensitive), bestMatches silently falls back to the crude line-anchored pattern, which applies NO typographic-noise stripping and captures the entire rest of the physical line verbatim as the heading text
findings.description: ARTICLE_PATTERNS[1] (the line-anchored fallback, `/^ARTICLE\s+([IVXLC]+|\d+)\.?\s*([^\n]*)$/gim`) has no title-shape validation at all and is never run through stripTrailingTypographicNoise or any noise-stripping - unlike the primary shape-based pattern, it simply captures every character to end-of-line. Before ciKeyword, a fully-lowercase ARTICLE heading ('article vi covenants...') at a non-line-start position was invisible outright (no pattern could reach it), so this fallback's own crudeness was never exposed on this shape. Now that ciKeyword makes the keyword case-insensitive, a fully-lowercase-title ARTICLE heading is 'recognized' but via this crude fallback, glueing a trailing footnote digit and parenthetical aside straight into what is presented as the node's own heading text.

concreteReproduction.inputText: article vi covenants (the "Covenants")1\nsection 6.01 indebtedness. The Borrower shall not incur Indebtedness.
concreteReproduction.note: Node parentage/typing is NOT corrupted in this case (sectionRef 'vi' and 'VI'-relative parentage are internally consistent) - this is purely a heading-text data-quality regression, reported for completeness but not counted toward the primary rank-stack-corruption falsification.

investigatedButNotCountedAsAFinding.title: A lowercase ARTICLE keyword mid-sentence followed by a lowercase-titled SECTION fails to recognize the ARTICLE at all
investigatedButNotCountedAsAFinding.whyExcluded: Directly verified via isolated control probing that this reproduces IDENTICALLY with the ARTICLE keyword in its original CORRECT case ('Article VII EVENTS OF DEFAULT' followed by a lowercase-titled Section) - it is a pre-existing, orthogonal structural requirement of ARTICLE_PATTERNS[0]'s own end-of-title lookahead (`(?=\s+[A-Z][a-z]|\s*$)`, which requires the text immediately following an ALL-CAPS title to itself begin with a new capitalized word, or be the end of the document) that is completely unrelated to and unaffected by ciKeyword's case-insensitivity fix. Confirmed with the control test in describe block 4 (same shape, ARTICLE keyword correctly capitalized, SECTION keyword correctly capitalized) which PASSES. Not reported as a FINDING-1 falsification because this remediation did not touch, and never claimed to fix, this mechanism.

dispositionRationale: Workstream A's Part A remediation (docs/phase-3f1-6-rx-final-terminal-closure/03-structural-heading-final-remediation.json) is genuinely NOT phrase-list-dependent - direct code inspection and two fresh positive-control tests (novel invented phrasing; lowercase keyword after a semicolon, a position/punctuation combination not in either committed suite) confirm the positional-evidence architecture holds exactly as designed for the cases it was built to cover. However, this independent adversarial pass found a genuine, general, reproducible false-negative gap in the SAME mechanism the remediation itself introduced (stripTrailingFootnoteMarker / stripTrailingTypographicNoise): a footnote/endnote marker glued to a bare closing bracket or quotation mark, with no separate terminal-punctuation character of its own, is not recognized as typographic noise at all, and - for a first-level ARTICLE - reproduces the EXACT 'child re-parented to parentSectionRef: null' rank-stack corruption the original finding named verbatim. This is a fresh construction, distinct from every case in both committed remediation test files (part-b-recert-blocker1-independent-adversarial.test.ts and structural-heading-final-remediation-adversarial.test.ts, both grepped in full before writing this file), and is at least as realistic a real-world PDF-extraction/drafting shape as the punctuation-glued case the remediation did fix (a sentence commonly ends at a closing quote/parenthesis - a quoted defined term or parenthetical qualifier - with no separate period, and a colliding superscript footnote glyph is well documented to displace or merge with adjacent punctuation during plain-text extraction). A secondary, lower-severity data-quality regression (garbage heading text, not corrupted parentage) was also found and is reported for completeness. Per the phase's own disposition rule, a genuine reproducible defect in the SAME failure class the finding names bars CERTIFIED_CLOSED. No production code was modified to fix or work around this, consistent with the Part B production freeze and this task's explicit prohibition on touching lib/, app/, or prisma/.

overallSummary: FINDING-1 (structural heading false negatives): STILL_OPEN. Part A's ciKeyword and BOUNDED_GAP mechanisms hold under fresh adversarial attack and are confirmed to be genuinely general (not phrase-list-based) via direct code inspection plus two passing positive-control tests. However, the stripTrailingFootnoteMarker/stripTrailingTypographicNoise mechanism - the piece of the SAME remediation specifically built to fix the footnote-marker/rank-stack-corruption category - has a fresh, general, reproducible gap: a footnote digit glued to a bare closing bracket/quote (no separate terminal punctuation) is not recognized as noise, and for a first-level ARTICLE this reproduces the original finding's own named failure mode verbatim (child reparented to parentSectionRef: null). A secondary heading-text-quality regression was also found and documented. 4 of 7 fresh assertions fail against the current code; the JSON above and the committed test file are the concrete reproduction evidence.
